# Planes Research

Section: Research Path > Makes available

## Planes

[![Planesresearch](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/1/11/Planesresearch.png/revision/latest?cb=20240421184607)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/1/11/Planesresearch.png/revision/latest?cb=20240421184607)

### Research Points

20

### Research Time

1h 50m

## Research Path

### Unlocked by

[Helicopters](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Helicopters_Research)

### Makes available

[Heavy Aircraft](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Heavy_Aircraft_Research)

### Makes available

[Jets](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Jets_Research)

Planes is a [researchable](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Research) item which unlocks the following components:

| Category | Component |
| --- | --- |
| [Propulsion](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Wiki/Building/Components/Propulsion) | Medium Engine |
| [Propulsion](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Wiki/Building/Components/Propulsion) | Aircraft Propeller |
| Specialist Equipment | Outfit Inventory (Parachute) |
| [Vehicle Control](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Wiki/Building/Components/Vehicle_Control) | Wing Front Section (Small) |
| [Vehicle Control](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Wiki/Building/Components/Vehicle_Control) | Wing Section (Small) |
| [Vehicle Control](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Wiki/Building/Components/Vehicle_Control) | Wing Section (Medium) |
| [Vehicle Control](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Wiki/Building/Components/Vehicle_Control) | Control Surface (Medium) |
| [Vehicle Control](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Wiki/Building/Components/Vehicle_Control) | Large Landing Wheel |
